name: toolshop-playwright-framework
description: Playwright + TypeScript test framework for the Toolshop web shop: UI, API, accessibility and visual tests.

scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --network host --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e ENV=local -e VISUAL=1 -e CI mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.57.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --network host --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e ENV=local -e VISUAL=1 -e CI mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.57.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots=all
